notes: Holding returns are TOTAL returns: (exit close + cash dividends with ex-date after entry) / entry - 1, no reinvestment (Yahoo events=div, vendor units). Benchmarks are PRICE indices (^GDAXI is itself a total-return index).

Delisting rule: exit bar more than 5 weekdays before min(end, today) => last close + dividends up to end, flagged exit=last_close_before_delisting; kept in the primary result, excluded in the sensitivity run.
Weights are renormalised over priced holdings: each basket is equal-weighted among the holdings that have data, not over all decisions.
'Priced' = has an entry price and a close after entry (entry and exit).
Bootstrap: 10000 resamples, seed 20261020, percentile 95% CI; markets with <10 priced holdings on either side are marked 'too small to interpret'.
